meta.defaultDescription: Given Coffee is a single-origin specialty coffee exporter from Lintong, North Sumatra. Wet-hulled Arabica, directly traded from family farms around Lake Toba, shipped worldwide.

hero.title: Taste the origin, straight from the farm.
hero.subtitle: Given Coffee sources single-origin Arabica from family farms around Lake Toba, North Sumatra — and exports it with full traceability, from cherry to container.

about.title: Born on the shores of Lake Toba
about.body: Given Coffee began with a simple idea: the people who grow the coffee should be seen, and the people who drink it should know exactly where it comes from. We work directly with farmers in the highlands of North Sumatra, pay above market rates, and measure quality at every step.

product.title: Arabika Lintong
product.subtitle: Single-origin Arabica from Sumatra
product.body: A semi-washed Arabica grown at 1,400–1,700 masl on the plateau south-west of Lake Toba. Heavy body, low acidity, and a full, earthy cup with notes of cocoa and cedar. Our flagship export lot — cupped and graded before it ever leaves the warehouse.

hero.title: The land that gives, and the hands that give back.
hero.subtitle: How a group of North Sumatra farmers and coffee traders became Given Coffee.

story.title: Coffee is the reason we met.
story.body: Given Coffee started with a friendship between a farmer and a trader who shared one frustration: the best Indonesian coffee was being exported in bulk, blended, and sold without a name. The farmer who grew it was invisible.
story.body2: We decided to change that. Today we work with a small network of family farms around Lake Toba in North Sumatra — mostly in Lintong, Doloksanggul and the wider Humbang Hasundutan regency — buying their harvest directly, paying above market, and bringing each lot to the world with its origin intact. The coffee carries a name, a farm, and an altitude. That is the 'given' in our name — what the land gives us, we give forward.

origin.title: From the high plateau of Lintong
origin.body: Our flagship lot comes from family farms in Lintong, on the high plateau south-west of Lake Toba, North Sumatra. Cool nights, volcanic soil and elevations above 1,400 meters give the cherries their density — and the coffee its character. Like most Sumatran arabica, it is processed wet-hulled (giling basah), which gives the beans their bluish tint and the cup its famously low acidity and heavy body.

steps.title: Cherry
steps.text: Hand-picked ripe cherries, sorted on the same day.

steps.title: Pulping & hulling
steps.text: Wet-hulled (giling basah) the traditional Sumatran way — pulped, fermented and hulled in parchment within hours of harvest.

steps.title: Drying
steps.text: Sun-dried on raised beds until moisture hits export grade.

steps.title: Milling
steps.text: Dry milled, graded and rested before export.

steps.title: Roasting
steps.text: Roasted to order for our retail partners.

sustainability.title: Good coffee shouldn't cost the earth
sustainability.body: We work with farms that use shade-grown, agroforestry methods — protecting soil and forest while producing better cherries. We pay at harvest time, support farm-gate pricing, and reinvest part of every sale into the farming communities we buy from. Certification is on our roadmap; the practice already runs through everything we do.

quote.text: We don't sell beans. We sell the work of people who wake before sunrise to grow something honest — and we make sure the world knows their name.

hero.title: Lintong, from the shores of Lake Toba.
hero.subtitle: Single-origin Arabica Lintong — Indonesia
hero.body: Grown on family farms around Lake Toba and wet-hulled the traditional Sumatran way — a heavy, low-acid cup that carries its origin from cherry to container. One origin, three forms.

collection.title: One lot, three ways to enjoy it
collection.body: Every product is the same Lintong lot — traced from a named farm to your shelf. Choose the form that fits your ritual.

story.title: Why this coffee is special
story.body: Given Coffee is grown at 1,400–1,700 meters on the high plateau of Lintong, Doloksanggul, North Sumatra — a region with cool nights and mineral-rich volcanic soil that give the cherries their density. Processed wet-hulled (giling basah), it keeps a heavy body and famously low acidity: cocoa, earth and a whisper of cedar in the cup.
story.body2: We keep it simple on purpose: no blending, no flavoring, no shortcuts. Just a traceable, single-origin lot with a cupping score we stand behind.
